title: Colleen Hendry (Boailoop founder) — 'easily my favorite book I've read in quite some time'
summary: Colleen Hendry — product leader building Boailoop — endorses Incorruptible as her favorite book she's read in quite some time. Names the questions the book raised about leadership, incentives, and how companies lose their way as directly relevant to her consulting work and to Boailoop.
blockquote: Incorruptible by Eric Ries is easily my favorite book I've read in quite some time. The stories alone are incredible, but what really stayed with me were the questions it raised about leadership, incentives, how companies lose their way, and how we make better decisions. It was one of those rare books that had me constantly connecting what I was hearing to my own experience, my consulting work, and what I'm building with Boailoop.
